nodes.body:
Landed in cacbd460ccad99c1d583d0693553a1bd62b7d0af.

- **Bug:** for live-listed providers (Together, Tencent and other refreshable catalogs), a listed model missing from the plugin's built-in rows got discovery defaults: 128k context, a 32k output cap and text-only input. The hosted catalog's row for that model was ignored.
- **Fix:** `ModelRegistry` now describes each listed ID with the planner's effective catalog row (bundled plus hosted) at read time. The listing still decides which models exist, and stored rows are unchanged.
- **Proof:** the regression test fails on base and passes here. In the real base vs branch Gateway E2E, Together Kimi-K3 went from 128k text-only with `max_tokens` 32768 to 1M text+image with `max_tokens` ≈1M. The controls did not change. The local review was clean and CI was green on the exact head.

Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes Enrich live-listed models with hosted catalog metadata while preserving account-controlled model availability. **Example:** Together lists moonshotai/Kimi-K3, which has a hosted catalog row but no bundled plugin row. - **Before:** The reported Gateway comparison shows 128,000 context tokens, text-only input, and max_tokens 32768. - **After:** The reported branch comparison shows 1,048,576 context tokens, text and image input, and max_tokens 1020067. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | The repair has clear value and useful Gateway observations, but optional-field handling is incorrect and the repository-required live proof remains incomplete. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Real behavior proof is not required for maintainer- or bot-authored pull requests. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 2 actionable review findings remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Live-listed models absent from bundled rows show understated context limits and missing image support, and receive an incorrect output cap. **Reason:** The change restores the documented split between account-owned availability and catalog-owned metadata, and its maintainer-authored direction needs no additional product approval. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 2 items remain** This PR addresses a current catalog bug and should remain open, but sparse catalog rows expose two correctness problems in the proposed enrichment. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58` ## Before merge - [ ] **Preserve discovered capabilities when catalog fields are omitted (P2)** - A valid hosted row can provide contextWindow 1048576 and maxTokens 65536 while omitting input and reasoning. If discovery reported input ["text", "image"] and reasoning true, normalizeModelCatalogProviderRows supplies input ["text"] and reasoning false for those omissions. Spreading metadata here then replaces the discovered capabilities, making a previously image-capable reasoning model text-only and non-reasoning. Preserve field presence through the existing planner/projection boundary and apply defaults after merging; add a regression with omitted catalog fields. - [ ] **Enrich partial catalog rows without requiring both token limits (P2)** - The hosted schema permits contextWindow and maxTokens independently, but buildEffectiveManifestProviderConfig discards every row missing either value. For a listed model with discovered maxTokens 32768 and a hosted row containing contextWindow 1048576 and image input but no maxTokens, catalogModel is absent and this function returns the unchanged 128000/text-only discovery row. Fill the omitted limit from discovery before complete runtime materialization so the available hosted fields still apply. ## Findings - [P2] Preserve discovered capabilities when catalog fields are omitted — `src/agents/sessions/model-registry-sources.ts:224-226` - [P2] Enrich partial catalog rows without requiring both token limits — `src/agents/sessions/model-registry-sources.ts:211-212` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Provide redacted output from an isolated Gateway using a real provider/model with a hosted-only row, showing corrected model metadata and an accepted agent request; remove IPs, keys, phone numbers, and private endpoints.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Provider discovery supplies account-listed models, and ModelRegistry combines admitted inventory with catalog metadata for model lists, runtime resolution, context sizing, and request limits. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Account model listing] --> D[Model registry] B[Bundled catalog] --> C[Effective catalog planner] H[Hosted catalog] --> C C --> D D --> E[Picker and model lists] D --> F[Runtime model resolution] F --> G[Context and request limits] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep enrichment in the existing registry and planner boundary, preserving omitted metadata and filling missing limits from discovery before runtime materialization. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source inspection establishes the main-branch metadata gap and both sparse-row failures; this read-only review executed no target code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The registry is the appropriate shared owner, but converting optional catalog metadata into complete runtime models before merging loses omission semantics. Full review comments: - [P2] Preserve discovered capabilities when catalog fields are omitted — `src/agents/sessions/model-registry-sources.ts:224-226` A valid hosted row can provide contextWindow 1048576 and maxTokens 65536 while omitting input and reasoning. If discovery reported input ["text", "image"] and reasoning true, normalizeModelCatalogProviderRows supplies input ["text"] and reasoning false for those omissions. Spreading metadata here then replaces the discovered capabilities, making a previously image-capable reasoning model text-only and non-reasoning. Preserve field presence through the existing planner/projection boundary and apply defaults after merging; add a regression with omitted catalog fields. Confidence: 0.98 - [P2] Enrich partial catalog rows without requiring both token limits — `src/agents/sessions/model-registry-sources.ts:211-212` The hosted schema permits contextWindow and maxTokens independently, but buildEffectiveManifestProviderConfig discards every row missing either value. For a listed model with discovered maxTokens 32768 and a hosted row containing contextWindow 1048576 and image input but no maxTokens, catalogModel is absent and this function returns the unchanged 128000/text-only discovery row. Fill the omitted limit from discovery before complete runtime materialization so the available hosted fields still apply. Confidence: 0.98 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.96 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [a117ca507362](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a117ca5073622d67cc518902dbc5e5723743d00d). ### Provenance checked - `Generated catalog admission and registry loading` keeps the original intent (625945b7ae01d5eea91aba5285da1a327b2a5f9f: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/192552 kept optional execution modules off startup paths while preserving configured scope and later catalog refreshes.) - `Dynamic manifest-row publication filter` keeps the original intent (7dcd9a34be0d3e67df7c81ff306e6d2579db322b: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175258 preserved catalog ordering and account visibility while consolidating metadata ownership; this PR retains the filter.) - `Registry source composition and route separation` keeps the original intent (f7a419aeaf720d655e47d177a5e0de2322d5be24: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/143837 composed inventory before lookup while keeping request credentials separate and preserving explicit routes.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - pnpm test src/agents/sessions/model-registry.catalog-description.test.ts src/model-catalog/manifest-planner.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - pnpm test src/agents/agent-tools.prefix-stability.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - pnpm tsgo:core - git diff --check What I checked: - **Introduced change and current-main gap:** The pinned introduced diff replaces generated-provider admission with read-time enrichment; fetched main retains the plain admission filter and lacks this enrichment. ([`src/agents/sessions/model-registry.core.ts:481`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58/src/agents/sessions/model-registry.core.ts#L481), [5b7de7ab5741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58)) - **Optional metadata becomes overriding defaults:** Hosted rows permit omitted input and reasoning fields, but catalog normalization supplies text-only input and false reasoning before the new metadata spread overwrites discovery. ([`packages/model-catalog-core/src/model-catalog-normalize.ts:723`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58/packages/model-catalog-core/src/model-catalog-normalize.ts#L723), [5b7de7ab5741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58)) - **Sparse rows are discarded by the selected converter:** buildEffectiveManifestProviderConfig drops a row unless both contextWindow and maxTokens exist, although both fields are optional in the hosted catalog schema. ([`src/plugins/provider-catalog.ts:214`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58/src/plugins/provider-catalog.ts#L214), [5b7de7ab5741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58)) - **Existing ownership contract:** Model-listing policy assigns model existence to authenticated discovery and metadata enrichment to the catalog; the PR retains the existing admission filter and does not add unlisted IDs. ([`src/plugins/AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58/src/plugins/AGENTS.md), [5b7de7ab5741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b7de7ab5741fa86e46fd42c97505d5881649b58)) - **Prior composition work:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/143837 established registry source composition, route preservation, and current request-setting ownership; its body and human closeout support retaining that boundary. ([`src/agents/model-catalog.ts:179`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f7a419aeaf720d655e47d177a5e0de2322d5be24/src/agents/model-catalog.ts#L179), [f7a419aeaf72](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7a419aeaf720d655e47d177a5e0de2322d5be24)) - **Supplied behavior evidence:** The complete PR body records base-versus-branch dist Gateway observations for Together and Tencent using dummy credentials, a loopback hosted catalog, and a TLS mock; discussion contains no additional provider run.
